name: Question 11
problem:
A particle $P$ is traveling along the $x$-axis with displacement $s(t)$ from a fixed origin $O$ given by

$$
s(t)=t{e}^{-t},\,t\ge 0.
$$

Find the time at which the acceleration is zero, and find the value of the velocity at this moment.

Question 11
?

A particle P is traveling along the x-axis with displacement s(t) from a fixed origin O given by s(t)=te−t,t≥0. Find the time at which the acceleration is zero, and find the value of the velocity at this moment.

a
t=1,v=1e
b
t=3,v=3e3
c
t=2,v=1e2
d
t=3,v=−1e3
e
t=2,v=−1e2
